name: Zeboiim
brief: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom
short: Zeboiim, one of the cities of the plain, along with Sodom and Gomorrah, that was destroyed by God due to its wickedness (<ref="Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8">Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8</ref>).
